metadata.title: Retrieve Bank Data Sharing Consent by ConsentId

content.title: Retrieve Bank Data Sharing Consent by ConsentId

blocks.text:
{
  "type": "string",
  "enum": [
    "AwaitingAuthorization",
    "Authorized",
    "Rejected",
    "Revoked",
    "Expired",
    "Consumed",
    "Suspended"
  ],
  "description": " Specifies the status of a consent.\n \n | Consent Status| State Type| Description|\n |---------------|-----------|------|\n | AwaitingAuthorization | Pending | The consent is awaiting authorization.|\n | Authorized | In Use | The consent has been successfully authorized.|\n | Rejected | Terminal | The unauthorized consent has been rejected at the LFI.|\n | Revoked | Terminal | The consent has been revoked at the TPP or LFI.|\n | Expired | Terminal | The consent is now expired.|\n | Consumed | Terminal | The consented action(s) have either been completed successfully.|\n | Suspended | In Use | The consent has been suspended, pending further enquiries.|"
}

{
  "type": "string",
  "enum": [
    "ReadAccountsBasic",
    "ReadAccountsDetail",
    "ReadBalances",
    "ReadBeneficiariesBasic",
    "ReadBeneficiariesDetail",
    "ReadFXTransactionsBasic",
    "ReadFXTransactionsDetail",
    "ReadFXRemittanceCharges",
    "ReadTransactionsBasic",
    "ReadTransactionsDetail",
    "ReadProduct",
    "ReadScheduledPaymentsBasic",
    "ReadScheduledPaymentsDetail",
    "ReadDirectDebits",
    "ReadStandingOrdersBasic",
    "ReadStandingOrdersDetail",
    "ReadStatements",
    "ReadPartyUser",
    "ReadPartyUserIdentity",
    "ReadParty",
    "ReadProductFinanceRates"
  ],
  "description": "The permission codes available to the TPP for Bank Data Sharing and agreed with the User."
}

{
  "type": "string",
  "enum": [
    "CurrentAccount",
    "Savings",
    "CreditCard",
    "Mortgage",
    "Finance"
  ],
  "description": "Specifies the sub type of account (product family group). Supported values:\n\n* CurrentAccount\n\n* Savings\n\n* CreditCard\n\n* Mortgage\n\n* Finance"
}

{
  "description": "Error Code. This may either be one of the prescribed Error Code(s) or a namespaced Error Code where the namespace is the system or organisation that has responded with the error, and the code is the code specific to the system or organisation.",
  "type": "string",
  "anyOf": [
    {
      "enum": [
        "Consent.Invalid",
        "Consent.BusinessRuleViolation",
        "Consent.FailsControlParameters",
        "Consent.InvalidUserIdentifier",
        "JWS.InvalidSignature",
        "JWS.Malformed",
        "JWS.InvalidClaim",
        "JWS.InvalidHeader",
        "JWE.DecryptionError",
        "JWE.InvalidHeader",
        "GenericRecoverableError",
        "GenericError",
        "Event.UnexpectedEvent",
        "Body.InvalidFormat",
        "Resource.InvalidFormat"
      ]
    },
    {
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z]+\\.[A-Za-z0-9]+$"
    }
  ]
}
